why: R11-06 asks a DECLARED allowance to show that the attempt to replace it with a published number is on the record.  D-792 recorded three documents as unobtainable from this environment; D-793 re-attempted all three, and the Molex product specification RETRIEVED.

attempts.direct_result: HTTP/2 INTERNAL_ERROR, then connection timeout on HTTP/1.1 (same as the D-792 attempt)
attempts.revision_note: Every row this repository already depended on -- 4.2 rated current, 4.3 derating reference, 4.4 ambient range, 6.1.5 temperature rise, 6.2.2 crimp pull-out, section 10 free-wire length -- is present and IDENTICAL in the A1 copy.  The three contact-resistance rows D-793 now RULES at are read from it.
attempts.what_it_changed: R12-01.  Contact resistance moves from DECLARED 20 mOhm initial / 30 mOhm aged and 1 mOhm per crimp to the manufacturer's published 20 mOhm initial (6.1.1, conductor subtracted), 5 mOhm per crimped portion (6.1.4) and 40 mOhm post-durability/post-environmental (6.2.6-6.2.8, 6.3.1-6.3.7).  All three become GUARANTEED_MAX.

attempts.result: not re-attempted separately: 5055700003-PS is the specification the fitted 505570 receptacle housing and 505572 terminal are governed by, and it retrieved.
HTTP 404 at D-792; not re-attempted at D-793.
attempts.stands_in: the inductor's core-loss fraction remains DECLARED_ESTIMATE with C-DISP-01 as the measurement of record.  The DCR figure that RULES is the manufacturer's published MAXIMUM 57.4 mOhm and is unaffected.

declared_values_that_still_stand_in_for_: panel.logic_and_touch_mA -- the EastRising module datasheet RETRIEVED at D-792 and publishes NO active-mode supply current; the 50 mA is a statement about the evidence and is measured at C-DISP-01
path.pack_ac_to_dc_multiplier -- the 785060 pack publishes an AC 1 kHz impedance only; the 2.5x DC widening is declared and measured at C-BAT-PATH-01
path.f1_fuse_max_ohm and path.f1_fuse_tolerance -- Littelfuse publishes no cold-resistance row for the 0466005
path.gnd_return_squares -- a pour cannot be walked by a track graph; the 12 squares are a declared 2.7x widening on the geometric estimate
usb.* source-path terms -- the USB cable is a CONTRACT with a measurable acceptance criterion at U11 pin 10 (C-CHG-01) rather than a datasheet number
pass_pair.land_above_internal_air_K -- 5 K is a declared allowance, measured at C-BAT-GATE-01
